screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a histogram of the invariant mass of muon pairs recorded by the CMS detector in 2011. Peaks mark particles that decayed into two muons.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls choose how the histogram is filled, one pair at a time, as a stream, or all at once, and switch between the full spectrum and the Z region. A fit panel measures the Z boson's mass, width and lifetime.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Add a few pairs by hand, then stream events and watch the peaks appear.
